title: A Bridge for the Harbor
author: Jude Iversen
blurb: Elodie Vane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
